summary: Ralph M. Martin, 75, of Longmont was caught in sailboat rigging at Carter Lake Marina during a storm accompanied by strong wind; he died the next day (2020-05-20) of sudden cardiac arrest and blunt force trauma, per the Larimer County Coroner.
